usageNotes: Adds a Proxmox node (or an external peer) to an existing SDN fabric. The fabric must already exist and the caller needs SDN.Allocate on /sdn/fabrics/{fabric_id} plus Sys.Modify on /nodes/{node_id}. Protocol-specific fields apply: 'wireguard' uses allowed_ips, endpoint, public_key, and role; routing protocols (ospf, openfabric, bgp) primarily use interfaces and ip/ip6. After adding nodes, apply the pending SDN configuration via PUT /cluster/sdn to push changes cluster-wide.

examples.summary: Add a WireGuard peer node to fabric 'wgfab1'

tips: fabric_id must be 2–8 alphanumeric characters with optional interior hyphens; it cannot start or end with a hyphen.
For WireGuard external nodes, supply public_key — it is required for peers outside the Proxmox cluster.
Use the digest param (obtained from GET /cluster/sdn/fabrics/{fabric_id}) to guard against concurrent SDN config edits.
Returns null on success — confirm the node was added by fetching GET /cluster/sdn/fabrics/node/{fabric_id}.
Changes are staged; run PUT /cluster/sdn afterward to apply and propagate the updated configuration across all nodes.
